Embedding request with explicit dimensions parameter returns embeddings of the requested size

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"dimensions\":256,\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}", EmbeddingRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.embed(request)
    println(result)
}
```
